cohort: Every emitted TypeScript candidate from completed round08; selection uses language and emission availability only.
hypothesis: Paired compiler diagnostics can distinguish call applicability errors from type-invalid structural observers. A restricted projection may retain valid observations after input composition.
provider_approval_not_required: Runs only the installed compiler in network-disabled case containers.
analysis_policy: Compile the original program pair; attempt the same observation projection for every result; recompile every projected program. Keep unknown environments explicit.
limitations: Types may contain candidate bugs. Treat diagnostics as counterevidence, not complete semantic truth.
The census alone cannot establish defect detection or whole-test validity.
